description: This file defines a template class 'Lockable' that adds locking capabilities to a class via composition, using a mutex-like 'Core::CriticalSection' for thread safety. It is part of the 'WPEFramework::ProcessContainers' namespace and includes mechanisms for locking and unlocking critical sections.

classes.name: Lockable
classes.description: A template class that provides thread-safe locking mechanisms to derived classes or composed objects, using a mutable critical section.

methods.name: InternalLock
methods.description: Locks the internal critical section to ensure thread safety.
